Name: Chest Locator
Author: Dokerda
Description:
This mod helps you quickly locate items in your nearby chests.
While hovering over any item in your inventory, press [b]F[/b] to highlight all nearby chests containing that item.
Features:

[list]
[*]Highlights chests with a small exclamation mark above them.
[*]Works for all items in your inventory.
[*]Simple and lightweight, no extra UI clutter.
[/list]Most of the languages (except English and Turkish) were translated using automated tools. If you encounter any grammatical errors, unnatural phrasing, or formatting issues, please let me know in the [b]Posts[/b] or [b]Bugs[/b] section. Your feedback is greatly appreciated as I want to make this mod accessible and polished for everyone!

Please consider endorsing if you find this mod useful! ❤️

Also available in Curse Forge! https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/chest-locator
